_note: Frozen at the real 2026 regular-season end (Coke Zero Sugar 400, Daytona, Aug 29 2026) per the FL constitution's playoff-freeze rule. NASCAR resets all 16 Chase qualifiers' points to a seed-based scale (2100 down to 2000 in 16 playoff-points-adjusted steps) at the start of the postseason, so live in-season scraping after this date reflects reset/ongoing playoff totals, not real regular-season standing -- comparing that against the 2 drivers who missed the Chase (who keep accumulating on the old unreset scale) is apples-to-oranges. The 11 Chase qualifiers below use NASCAR's official post-Daytona seed points (Wikipedia, 2026 Coke Zero Sugar 400 article, 'Official driver's standings' table). Shane van Gisbergen and Ross Chastain did not qualify; NASCAR does not publish reset points for non-qualifiers, so their values here are placeholders below 2000 that preserve their reported real-world order (van Gisbergen missed the final Chase berth by 17 points to Ryan Preece; Chastain had been mathematically eliminated before the finale even ran) -- not official totals.
